2026-09-12: user's own call — represent the cost-reduction CONDITION (not the discount mechanism itself, which stays gap #7's own open item): 'probably as an additional sink of battlefield presence (tapped creature).' New `Constraints.tapped?: boolean` (synergy.ts) — same 'real, honest, documentary-only DATA, not consulted by satisfiesConstraints' treatment as `attacking`/`attachedToSelf`/`equippedBySelf` (checked: RealCard.tapped is real live per-instance state, but no pipeline routes it into the constraint matcher). New sink fact `{to:'Battlefield', types:{has:['Creature']}, tapped:true, value:-1}`, oracle-anchored on 'a tapped creature' (line 0). Deliberately a NEW field rather than reusing the existing top-level `Fact.tapped` (that one describes the fact's own subject entering/being tapped as part of the occurrence, e.g. Vector Imperial Capital's 'enters tapped' — a different meaning from 'is the candidate this constraint filters currently tapped'). compute-annotations.mjs re-run (6 facts). verify-synergy.mjs (scoped: 0 hard failures; full pool 314: 0 hard failures). vitest 238/238.

Migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md's `synergy.json` v2 unified schema — same rework as summon-bahamut/aerith-rescue-mission). Real oracle text (Scryfall-confirmed, data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #19): "This spell costs {2} less to cast if it targets a tapped creature.\nDestroy target nonland permanent." Instant, {4}{W}, cmc 5. Dropped the old v1 `id`/`sourceText`/`highlight` fields and the two controller-split sink facts (`wants-own-permanent`/`wants-opp-permanent`) in favor of ONE unconstrained sink fact (`{to:'Battlefield', types:{not:['Land']}}`, no `controller`) — same convention already established by venat-heart-of-hydaelyn-hydaelyn-the-mothercrystal's own real, identically-shaped "Exile target nonland permanent, no controller restriction" produce/want (checked as precedent before collapsing). No presence-shaped SOURCE facts (per the standing rule) — this is an Instant, so no entersBattlefield/dies-of-self facts apply; instead: `self-cast` ({event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}, typeLine-anchored 'Instant') and `self-graveyard` ({to:'Graveyard', controller:'you', subject:'self'}, typeLine-anchored 'Instant', CR 608.2m — the spell itself resolving into its owner's graveyard) mirror aerith-rescue-mission's own self-cast/self-graveyard pair exactly (same typeLine word annotated twice). The destroy effect follows the ACT-vs-CONSEQUENCE rule, mirroring summon-bahamut's own destroy-nonland/dies pair: a bare ACT tag `{event:'destroy', target:{types:{not:['Land']}}, targeted:true}` (CR 701.6, real CR 601.2c single mandatory target, not Bahamut's 'up to one' — no `optional`) plus a separate CONSEQUENCE `{event:'dies', from:'Battlefield', to:'Graveyard', target:{types:{not:['Land']}}, targeted:true}` (CR 700.4, unconditionally guaranteed once destroy actually resolves). Neither carries `subject` (the thing dying is a chosen TARGET, not this card itself — same 'omitted subject resolves to unknown, matches only unconstrained wants' rule the Gaius van Baelsar bug fix established) nor `controller` (the real text has no controller restriction on either side, same reasoning as the sink collapse above). All 5 facts annotated via compute-annotations.mjs (new annotations-authoring.json, positionally aligned) — card added to `ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS` (scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs). `Fact.value` deprioritized per standing 2026-09-11 decision — authored as -1 sentinel; a concurrent pool-wide compute-weights.mjs run (not run by this task) already resolved all 5 to real value:1 by the time this task finished. scenarios.ts migrated to the engine-trace pilot format (runEngineScenarios) to match the rest of the fin/1-10-era batch — one real scenario: casts targeting the opponent's real, NON-TOKEN Coeurl (same real FIN card summon-bahamut's own scenario A uses) so the destroy resolves to a literal harness.ts `fn:'destroy'` trace line (a token target would instead log `ceasesToExist`, which can't back a real `event:'destroy'` ACT fact as evidence — caught live via verify-synergy.mjs's first run, which is exactly why this card doesn't use a token filler the way the old v1 scenario's generic creaturesCount did). The cost-reduction clause ("costs {2} less... if it targets a tapped creature") is a real, textually-precise, still-open ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #7 case (alternative-cost-REDUCTION, distinct from the already-real Flashback-style cost REPLACEMENT) — documented there with this card as the concrete example, no fact authored for it (no engine backing to point to), `definition.ts`'s own `staticAbilities` freeform-text treatment left as-is (unchanged, already correct). `verify-synergy.mjs` (scoped + full pool): 0 hard failures for this card (5 expected soft notes: tapForMana ×5, plus one `enters` note for the real Coeurl setup entry — same shape every other engine-piloted scenario's own soft notes take). `npx vitest run functional-model`: 238/238. Real `find-synergies.mjs` diff (isolated via an old/new synergy.json swap, not a stale git-HEAD diff, since the pool has other concurrent uncommitted migrations in flight): lost the old v1 fact set's 5 controller='opp'-scoped `dying` lines + 18 controller='opp'-scoped, type-unconstrained `graveyard presence` lines (Judge Magister Gabranth/Sephiroth Fabled SOLDIER/Sephiroth Planet's Heir/Vincent Valentine/Zodiark Umbral God + Cantankerous Keepers/Eden Seat of the Sanctum/Elixir/Emet-Selch Unsundered/Ignis Scientia/Magic Pot/Qutrub Forayer/Rydia's Return/Sorceress's Schemes/Summon: Esper Ramuh/The Emperor of Palamecia/Thranduil Sindarin Liege/Vanille Cheerful l'Cie) — all explained by dropping the old controller='opp'-split representation. Gained the new, correctly-typed replacements: 9 `dies` lines (same unconstrained-Graveyard-sink set summon-bahamut's own destroy-nonland/dies facts already match, since this fact is likewise subject-less/type-constrained-only) + 13 `moves to graveyard` lines (the new self-graveyard fact, subject:'self', so it resolves this card's own real type 'Instant' — broader than the 9 since it also satisfies controller='you'-scoped and Instant-type-constrained wants the old opp-scoped fact never could). The destroy SINK side (this card wanting a nonland permanent to target) is unchanged in kind from before (both old split facts and the new single unconstrained fact already matched the same ~122-126 real battlefield-presence/enters-the-battlefield producers pool-wide; the +4 net there is the single-fact collapse now also catching a few controller='you'-scoped producers the old opp-only-implied fact set's own real matches happened not to include) — not re-litigated further, matches the sink-collapse precedent (venat) exactly.
